items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then this is when I really met and got close with Jo Jones... we were really close then. And he lived in one of my sister's buildings.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was a pretty disastrous gig.

Right, right, right. And then the funny thing about it, -- and you know how musicians kid and things, and I said, Basie, you come here with that big raggedy band and that cold winter, and yo guys had those little trench coats on, and this weather was beating you to death. He said, that's right, right.

And then Willie Berg said -- Fox, who was the owner of the Grand Terrace called him up: "You've got to come here and get me some drums for this guy." Jo Jones had a snap drum and was sitting up on a -- this is what we used to do, though, didn't have no -- were so poor you didn't have no stand. You had a chair and you played -- (laughter.)
